messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started — staged rollout for redwood-api: v2.15.0 (build e3f7a). Target: canary 10% in us-east-1; next step: 10% global. Change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/v2.15.0 :rocket:

alex_m: watching p95 and error-rate dashboards
maggie: seeing p95 +12ms on embed endpoints in canary, errors on a subset of pods
sara_dev: any logs? paste relevant pod id
maggie: logs show repeated kvcache OOMs right before 500s

maggie: snippet:
```
2026-03-21T02:12:03Z redwood-api[pod-az3-99f]: kvcache: alloc failed: OOM
2026-03-21T02:12:03Z redwood-api[pod-az3-99f]: inference: 500 internal
```

javier_ops: Is this OOM from quantized model footprint change? v2.15 switched kernel to fused-attn
alex_m: yes v2.15.0 enabled fused kernels + larger kv prefetch, might push memory on low-GPU nodes
emily_releases: current canary is only in us-east-1. Are EU nodes affected yet?
maggie: not yet, only 3 pods in canary, all in us-east-1

alex_m: propose HOLD at 10% globally. Rollback EU/everything pending root cause. Suggest pin traffic for eu region to v2.14.0 and scale down canary pods for investigation
sara_dev: /deploy pause --reason "kvcache OOMs" <-- will that call deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Received pause command from sara_dev. Pausing staged rollout at 10%.

javier_ops: I'll pin eu route to v2.14.0 via routing service now: `routectl set pin redwood-api eu v2.14.0`

emily_releases: Noted — update release notes: add known issue (kvcache OOMs on fused kernel). Link: https://go/redwood/releases/v2.15.0/notes

maggie: running heap profiles and pod-level memory metrics, will report back in 10m
alex_m: ops, if we confirm it's kernel memory regression we can ship a quick patch to disable fused-attn in v2.15 and re-run canary
sara_dev: 👍 agree. Let's keep the change window open until 03:30UTC; if we can't root cause by then we'll roll back

emily_releases: log this as a release hold + pin. I'll notify customer-success and update the status page

deploy-bot: Staged rollout paused at 10% by sara_dev (reason: kvcache OOMs). Auto-rollback disabled. Incident tag: rel-2026-1797772468

alex_m: thanks team — will post findings and a decision by 02:25 UTC
maggie: preliminary trace: allocation spike correlates with long-context requests + batching. Could be differing sequence length distribution in canary traffic
javier_ops: If confirmed, we can patch runtime to cap kv prefetch and resume canary

emily_releases: adding preflight checklist item: "verify kvcache footprint under mixed seq-length" before resuming

sara_dev: consensus: HOLD at 10% + pin EU to v2.14.0. :thumbsup:

alex_m: moving to follow-up thread if we get mitigation steps
emily_releases: recorded — closing this thread when rollout resumes or rollback completes
